_comment: Who Am I? fields the Wikipedia infobox gets wrong or leaves out, by display name. role: for an infobox with no Role row, read the same way as an infobox role (see role() in gen_whoami.py). nick: the nickname to use, or null to use none, where the first one in the infobox is a giveaway or isn't a name people use. Check either against the player's page before adding it.
